name: openchargemap-mcp-server
description: MCP server for the global Open Charge Map EV charging registry: find stations by location and connector, get full station detail, resolve reference IDs, and read community reliability check-ins.

OPENCHARGEMAP_API_KEY.title: Open Charge Map API Key
OPENCHARGEMAP_API_KEY.description: Sent as the X-API-Key header on every request. Free instant signup at openchargemap.org.

OPENCHARGEMAP_REFERENCE_REFRESH.title: Refresh Reference Data On Startup
OPENCHARGEMAP_REFERENCE_REFRESH.description: When true, refresh reference data from the live OCM endpoint at startup (falls back to the bundled snapshot on failure). Leave false to stay fully offline.
